name: 338. Voyage text embeddings
description: TXE-6436: unified text embeddings, usage and unsupported parameters. Fixture rows use providerErrorFixture=1 with provider-error-fixture.config.json and provider-error-fixture.mjs; providerErrorFixtureUrl overrides the fixture URL when remapped to a free local port. The fixture counts the entire multi-input batch on both 200 and 500. Live rows cover all three price tiers. The neutral embeddings route preserves explicit extra_params as a nested vendor field; the OpenAI-compatible route promotes it and rejects model overrides. No rerank, multimodal or native Voyage route.

item.name: Voyage embeddings /v1/embeddings voyage-4

exec: pm.test('Voyage vectors and vendor usage', function () { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); pm.expect(b.data.length).to.equal(2); pm.expect(b.data[0].embedding.length).to.equal(256); pm.expect(b.usage.prompt_tokens).to.equal(b.usage.total_tokens); pm.expect(b.usage.total_tokens).to.be.above(0); });

item.name: Voyage embeddings fixture batch success voyage-4

exec: if (pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixture') !== '1') { pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
pm.variables.set('voyageBatchTag', 'voyage-batch-' + pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}'));
var b = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Voyage fixture status', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); });
pm.test('vendor usage preserved', function () { pm.expect(b.usage.prompt_tokens).to.equal(7); pm.expect(b.usage.total_tokens).to.equal(7); pm.expect(b.data.length).to.equal(3); });
pm.sendRequest(pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixtureUrl') + '/__wire', function (err, response) {

pm.test('one complete batch call, including on failure', function () { pm.expect(err).to.equal(null); var calls = response.json().data[0].calls.filter(function (c) { return c.path === '/v1/embeddings' && c.body.indexOf(pm.variables.get('voyageBatchTag')) !== -1; }); pm.expect(calls.length).to.equal(1); var wire = JSON.parse(calls[0].body); pm.expect(wire.input.length).to.equal(3); pm.expect(wire.output_dimension).to.equal(256); pm.expect(wire.input_type).to.equal('document'); pm.expect(wire.output_dtype).to.equal('float'); });

item.name: Voyage embeddings native nested extra_params preserve authorized model fixture /v1/embeddings voyage-4-lite

exec: if (pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixture') !== '1') { pm.execution.skipRequest(); }

pm.test('native route does not promote a nested model override', function () { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); var raw = b.extra_fields.raw_request; if (typeof raw === 'string') { raw = JSON.parse(raw); } pm.expect(raw.model).to.equal('voyage-4-lite'); pm.expect(raw.extra_params.model).to.equal('voyage-4-large'); });

item.name: [EXPECT-400] Voyage embeddings structural extra_params rejected /openai/v1/embeddings voyage-4-lite

exec: pm.test('extras cannot override the authorized Voyage model', function () { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(400); pm.expect(b.error.param).to.equal('extra_params.model'); });
